name: Matrix Trace Stress Formulation
description: Transforms the 2D vector Euclidean norm stress into a 2x2 symmetric matrix trace calculation. The algebraic minimum remains 4 per edge, but the relationship is obfuscated. Solvers must mathematically deduce that achieving 4m total stress requires every individual edge to have distinct channels, otherwise they cannot safely prune their search tree and will TLE on N=40.
